author: Akien
prose: whatslefttodo should not store data. it should not even be able to say 3 troubles when it's zero. this skill should just run a script. and that script should produce the same output in OperatorInbox.md (renamed from AkienInbox.txt because there will be more operators in the future — people are starting to look at this system now, so there will be more operators in the future. one operator is happy to be the operator, but it's OPERATOR attention not AKIEN attention). at the top it gives the totals. then TROUBLE TICKETS NEEDING OPERATOR ATTENTION. EMAIL NEEDING OPERATOR ATTENTION (messages via the bus to the operator and not resolved by their shim). instead of FINDINGS (that has two meanings in our system) we're gonna call that ADJUDICATIONS - they're asking for the operator to make a judgement. This includes the 'APPROVE THIS TICKET' or 'APPROVE THIS INTENTION'. Then OPEN QUESTIONS FOR OPERATOR, DESIGN NEEDING OPERATOR ATTENTION, TICKETS NEEDING OPERATOR ATTENTION, INTENTIONS NEEDING OPERATOR ATTENTION, IDEAS NEEDING OPERATOR ATTENTION. the order of things feels like the things at the top should mostly be empty. this isn't for CC to prepare in a skill every time from scratch. this is for deterministic python.
